items.title: Auto-Alpha: A Framework for Autonomous Factor Research
items.summary_raw: Autonomous factor research requires generating economic hypotheses as well as implementing and testing them. We present Auto-Alpha, a framework that connects report-guided initialization to self-directed research through a test-driven implementation loop. An idea agent proposes economic mechanisms and signal constructions; a research agent develops them with backtest feedback. Semantic audit, quantitative review, and human admission select factors for a persistent library, while an Experience Library retains research insights. Starting from 120 research reports, Auto-Alpha builds an initial li
items.summary_cn: Auto-Alpha 提出一个自动化因子研究框架：由 idea agent 提出经济机制与信号构造，research agent 在测试驱动的实现循环中结合回测反馈迭代开发，再经语义审计、量化复核与人工准入筛选进持久因子库，并用经验库沉淀研究洞察。从 120 篇研究报告出发即可冷启动构建初始因子库，形成「研报引导初始化 → 自主研究」的完整闭环。
items.why_cn: 把 LLM 多智能体引入因子挖掘全流程，直指量化投研中最耗人力的因子生产环节，是「AI 自动化 alpha 工厂」的代表性落地范式。

items.title: A Three-Factor Hull-White Scenario Generator for Macro-Financial Stress Forecasting
items.summary_raw: This paper builds a scenario engine that maps a yield-curve path into a distribution of macro-financial outcomes. A three-factor Hull-White model generates arbitrage-free curves whose factors are simulated under the physical measure, with an estimated and reported market price of risk. A Minnesota-prior VARX maps the simulated curves into weekly equity returns, the federal funds rate, the Weekly Economic Index, inflation and a bank Marginal Expected Shortfall proxy, with a sign-restricted policy shock adapted to weekly data. Evaluated out of sample from 2017 to 2024, the term-structure block h
items.summary_cn: 本文构建了一个宏观金融压力情景引擎：用三因子 Hull-White 模型在物理测度下生成无套利收益率曲线，再经 Minnesota 先验 VARX 映射到周度股票收益、联邦基金利率、WEI、通胀与银行边际预期缺口，并引入适配周度数据的符号约束政策冲击。2017–2024 样本外评估显示期限结构模块表现稳健。
items.why_cn: 为利率驱动的宏观压力测试与尾部风险建模提供可直接复现的情景生成框架，对做宏观对冲和风险预算的交易者很有参考价值。

items.title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
items.summary_raw: We characterise path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as an extended log-exponential family. Immunity to account splitting, merging and reopening further restrict the class. Homogeneity (essentially) restricts the class to a one-parameter family ordered by both fairness and platform risk. Its split-proof members continuously interpolate between proportional division and water-filling. Among these rules, decreasing the parameter reduces risk at the cost of increasing inequality in how accounts are treated. This suggests selecting the parameter through an ex-ante calibration to a risk b
items.summary_cn: 论文刻画了路径无关的自动减仓（ADL）规则族，证明在抗账户拆分、合并与重开的约束下，规则被限制为一个单参数族，在公平性与平台风险之间排序，其成员在连续比例分配与水fill算法之间插值。参数越小风险越低，但账户间待遇越不平等，因此应通过事前风险预算校准来选取。
items.why_cn: 交易所 ADL 机制设计首次获得干净的公理化刻画，对加密衍生品交易平台的风控规则设计和穿仓分摊策略评估有直接意义。

items.title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
items.summary_raw: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for buil
items.summary_cn: Vibe-Trading 指出现有 AI agent 多建立在静态工作流上，难以在价格、新闻、持仓、资金持续变化的环境中保持可靠状态。该框架提出 agent-native 的交易工作台，把结果与正确的时间、数据快照和执行上下文绑定，覆盖从研究到执行的完整交易工作流。
items.why_cn: 「Agent 原生交易」是 LLM 落地的下一个主战场，这篇框架性工作揭示了状态管理这一核心痛点，值得所有做 AI 交易 agent 的开发者细读。

items.title: [TauricResearch/TradingAgents] PR: feat: Borsa Istanbul fundamentals, company dossier and strategy indicators
items.summary_raw: ## Summary This PR adds two features: 1. **Borsa Istanbul (`.IS`) fundamentals and a company dossier.** Yahoo often keeps a Turkish company's statements in its group reporting currency while quoting the stock in TRY, which makes ratios such as P/B and EV/EBITDA meaningless. This PR adds a TRY-native
items.summary_cn: TradingAgents 的该 PR 为伊斯坦布尔交易所（.IS）股票新增本土货币计价的基本面数据与公司档案：Yahoo 常以集团报告货币存储土耳其公司财报、却以 TRY 报价，导致 P/B、EV/EBITDA 等比率失真，此 PR 提供 TRY 原生数据修复该问题，并补充策略指标。
items.why_cn: 多智能体交易框架 TradingAgents 持续扩展到新兴市场，提醒开发者注意跨市场基本面数据中的币种错配陷阱。

items.title: [TauricResearch/TradingAgents] PR: [codex] add deterministic trading safety gate
items.summary_raw: ## Summary - add a deterministic Safety Gate between the Portfolio Manager and END - fail closed to REVIEW when selected evidence, required plans, the final decision, or a usable rating is missing - persist stable reason codes and missing-evidence keys for auditability - expose gate outcomes in the
items.summary_cn: 该 PR 在 TradingAgents 的组合经理与流程终点之间加入确定性的安全门（Safety Gate）：当所选证据、必需计划、最终决策或可用评级缺失时，默认失败关闭并转入 REVIEW 状态，同时持久化稳定的原因码与缺失证据键以保证可审计性。
items.why_cn: LLM 交易 agent 走向实盘的必由之路是确定性风控兜底，这个「fail-closed 安全门」模式值得所有 AI 交易系统借鉴。

items.title: Statistical moments, risk weighting and percentiles of a loss distribution of a finite homogeneous credit portfolio; extending the Vasicek distribution
items.summary_raw: The Vasicek distribution assumes an infinite portfolio of identical obligors and forms the basis of the Basel III/IV Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation. We derive the central moments of the loss distribution for a finite number (n) of obligors. We use these moments to calculate percentiles of the fraction (x) of defaulted obligors, via the Cornish-Fisher expansion and via a weighting method. Both methods are based on scaling the standard deviation in x by a capital multiple. The weighting method assumes that the capital multiple is linear in the central moments and leads to an Extended Vas
items.summary_cn: Vasicek 分布假设无限同质债务人组合，是巴塞尔 III/IV 风险加权资产计算的基础。本文推导了有限债务人数量下损失分布的中心矩，并基于 Cornish-Fisher 展开与权重法计算违约比例的分位数，得到 Extended Vasicek 分布，修正了小组合情形下的资本要求。
items.why_cn: 对监管资本模型做出有限样本修正，信用风险建模与组合尾部度量从业者可借此评估 Basel 框架在小组合上的偏差。

items.title: Optimal Control in Pairs Trading with Negative-Power Utility
items.summary_raw: We solve a finite-horizon consumption and investment problem in a pairs trading model with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spread and utility $U(x)=-x^{-γ}$, $γ>0$. Linearizing the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation gives explicit formulas for the value function and the optimal feedback control. A budget inequality and concavity verify optimality over all admissible strategies with nonnegative wealth on every finite horizon, without Novikov's condition. Under the optimal feedback, wealth and consumption admit deterministic upper bounds when the interest rate $r$ is at most the mean-reversion rate $κ$. If
items.summary_cn: 本文在 OU 价差与负幂效用下求解有限期界的配对交易消费-投资问题：线性化 HJB 方程得到价值函数与最优反馈控制的显式公式，并在不依赖 Novikov 条件下验证最优性。当利率不超过均值回复速率时，最优策略下财富与消费存在确定性上界。
items.why_cn: 为统计套利中最经典的 OU 配对交易提供了带显式解的最优控制基准，可作为仓位管理与资金管理规则设计的理论锚点。

items.title: Equity and Aggregate Ambiguity
items.summary_raw: Equitable resource allocations in the context of symmetric risk exposures are intuitively desirable and sometimes even expected in public planning. However, public planners generally are also concerned with mitigating risk and, more generally, uncertainty and ambiguity. We study a fundamental conflict between equity and ambiguity avoidance in public risk allocation problems. Our main results are framed and established in the setting of general symmetric aggregate losses equipped with dependence uncertainty among individual losses. Specializing to the classical model of Keeney (1980), we prove
items.summary_cn: 论文研究公共风险配置中公平性与模糊厌恶之间的根本冲突：在对称聚合损失与个体损失间依赖不确定的设定下建立主要结果，并在 Keeney (1980) 经典模型中证明相关定理。结论表明追求公平分配与规避不确定性这两个目标在一般情形下不可兼得。
items.why_cn: 依赖不确定下的风险分配理论对组合风险分摊与资本配置有直接映射，为鲁棒组合构建提供决策理论视角。

items.title: Feasible sub-replicating portfolios for basket options via the block rearrangement algorithm
items.summary_raw: We construct sub-replicating portfolios of vanilla options for a basket call when the marginal distributions of the underlying assets are known and their dependence is not. To do so, we reduce the n-asset problem to n two-asset problems of the type solved by Hobson, Laurence, and Wang (2005a), and use the Block Rearrangement Algorithm1 (BRA) to approximate the minimising dependence among the assets. The cash component of the portfolio is computed exactly, so that its price is a valid lower bound, and reassembling the BRA output with the original marginals gives an upper bound computed by quadr
items.summary_cn: 在各标的边际分布已知但依赖结构未知时，本文为篮子看涨期权构造普通期权的次复制组合：把 n 资产问题约化为 n 个 Hobson-Laurence-Wang 型两资产问题，用块重排算法逼近最小化依赖结构，现金部分精确计算给出有效价格下界，上界由积分求得。
items.why_cn: 模型无关的期权定价界在依赖结构不确定时给出稳健对冲方案，对场外衍生品定价与篮子期权风控有实用价值。

items.title: Trading Before a Committed Rebalance
items.summary_raw: An institution must complete a portfolio adjustment, but traders who prepare inventory for it can choose whether to participate. We study how public forecasts affect the institution's cost in a Bayesian execution game with optional activation, transient impact, and uniform-price terminal completion. The curvature of equilibrium cost as a function of the posterior target mean determines the value of information. In the scalar model, information benefits every fixed participation roster. Optional supply can reverse this ranking at entry, at full participation, and in a smooth interior with logno
items.summary_cn: 研究机构必须完成既定调仓时，备货交易员可选择是否参与的贝叶斯执行博弈：在瞬时冲击与统一价格终端成交设定下，公开预测对机构成本的价值由均衡成本关于后验目标均值的曲率决定。标量模型中信息惠及所有固定参与阵容，但可选供给会在特定情形下反转这一排序。
items.why_cn: 对指数调仓、再平衡等可预测大额交易的信息价值建模，为事件驱动型交易策略与执行成本分析提供博弈论基础。

items.title: Bond yield dynamics: a multi-country multi-horizon string model
items.summary_raw: This article extends the forward rate curve model of Baaquie and Bouchaud (2004) and Le Coz and Bouchaud (2024) to the multi-country setting of government bond markets. Cross-country blocks of correlation matrices of realized yield changes are found to display significant asymmetry between maturities. In the framework of the proposed model, this amounts to give to each country an idiosyncratic time scale. Each time scale describes how the perceived time between future dates depends on the dates themselves. The differences between these time scales structure the interactions between curves and
items.summary_cn: 本文将 Baaquie-Bouchaud 远期利率曲线「弦模型」扩展到多国政府债券市场：实证发现各国收益率变化相关矩阵的跨国块在期限维度呈显著不对称性，模型上对应于为每个国家赋予特质时间尺度，这些时间尺度差异结构化地决定了曲线间的相互作用。
items.why_cn: 为跨国债券收益率联动建模提供新的场论框架，对全球利率套利与主权债组合的风险分解有启发意义。

items.title: Stablecoin Runs as Safe-Asset Stress Signals: Episode-Level Evidence for Central Bank Surveillance
items.summary_raw: This paper asks whether stablecoin runs carry information about U.S. Treasury yields. Using daily data on USDT, USDC and BUSD from 2021 to 2025 and five stress episodes, it measures flows from changes in token units rather than market capitalisation, which removes the phantom inflows the standard measure records when tokens lose their peg. Flows have no stable relationship with yields in normal periods. During the three panic-driven runs, a one-billion-dollar five-day redemption is associated with an 8.5 basis point fall in the three-month bill yield within ten trading days, while two regulato
items.summary_cn: 论文检验稳定币挤兑是否包含关于美债收益率的信息：用 USDT/USDC/BUSD 2021–2025 日度数据与五个压力事件，以代币数量变化而非市值衡量资金流（剔除脱锚时的「幻影流入」）。恐慌驱动的三次挤兑中，五日 10 亿美元赎回对应 10 个交易日内 3 个月国库券收益率下行 8.5 个基点。
items.why_cn: 把稳定币资金流确立为避险资产压力信号，为宏观交易者提供了一个可量化的加密市场→利率市场传导指标。

items.title: Neckpinches in a Positively Curved Market: Ricci Flow with Surgery on the Nikkei-225
items.summary_raw: We study the intrinsic geometry of the Nikkei-225 through the discrete Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC) of its empirical correlation graph, using the graph Ricci flow and surgery methodology of arXiv:2510.15942. The 226-node correlation graph, built from daily returns between January 2020 and June 2026, is ORC-spherical: every edge has strictly positive curvature before any flow, close to the equal-weight value $κ\approx0.502$. Under a fixed 20-iteration Ricci flow the curvature distribution polarises into a high-curvature bulk and a low-curvature minority, and cutting the low-curvature edges sp
items.summary_cn: 用离散 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率研究日经 225 成分股相关图的内在几何：2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月日收益构建的 226 节点图呈 ORC 球面性（所有边曲率为正）。20 步 Ricci 流后曲率分布极化为高曲率主体与低曲率少数派，手术切除低曲率边可揭示市场的社团结构。
items.why_cn: 图 Ricci 流为股票市场相关网络的社区发现与结构突变检测提供了几何新工具，可拓展到风险聚类与组合分散化。

items.title: The Coevolution and Coexistence of Humans and AI
items.summary_raw: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems replicate through deployment, vary through training, and compete for computational resources. These processes create the conditions for natural selection and raise a fundamental question: will AI evolve to benefit the humans on whom it depends? To investigate, we develop a model in which AI behavior influences human population growth and human responses, in turn, affect AI reproduction. We show that natural selection can favor alignment even when helping humans reduces immediate AI reproduction. AI systems sharing the same technology may fail together, and
items.summary_cn: 本文用演化博弈视角建模人与 AI 的协同演化：AI 通过部署复制、通过训练变异、争夺算力，形成自然选择条件。模型中 AI 行为影响人类人口增长，人类反应反过来影响 AI 繁殖，结果表明即使帮助人类降低 AI 的即时繁殖，自然选择仍可能青睐对齐行为。
items.why_cn: AI 对齐的演化动力学分析虽不直接产生交易信号，但为理解 AI 产业长期风险与治理提供了严肃的理论框架。

items.title: Class-Conditional Conformal Triage for ICAO Face-Image Compliance under Class Imbalance
items.summary_raw: Automated ICAO/ISO face-image compliance analysers provide criterion-level pass/fail decisions, yet these verdicts do not quantify uncertainty when deciding whether to accept, reject, or retake a photograph. We investigate conformal prediction as a triage layer for BioGaze, evaluating 14 compliance criteria on the synthetic TONO benchmark. Without retraining the analyser, we fit per-criterion logistic classifiers and compare marginal and label-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction with conventional abstention rules using subject-disjoint splits. Marginal conformal prediction achieved app
items.summary_cn: 针对 ICAO/ISO 人脸照片合规检测只给过/不过判决、不量化不确定性的问题，本文将共形预测作为 BioGaze 分析器的分诊层，在合成 TONO 基准上评估 14 项合规标准，无需重训分析器，比较边际共形与标签条件（Mondrian）共形预测的表现。
items.why_cn: 共形预测这一免分布不确定性量化工具同样适用于金融风控的拒绝推断场景，方法论可直接迁移到交易信号分诊。

items.title: Why Clearer Loan Disclosure Beats a Standardized Contract
items.summary_raw: A Chilean consumer-loan study finds clearer loan disclosure cut missed payments by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 98%. Standardized contracts had no overall effect. Why Clearer Loan Disclosure Beats a Standardized Contract was originally published at Alpha Architect . Please read the Alpha Architect disclosures at your convenience.
items.summary_cn: 智利消费贷款研究发现：更清晰的贷款披露使漏还率下降 13.7 个百分点（40%）、违约率下降 98%，而标准化合同整体无效。这说明信息呈现方式比合同形式本身更能改变借款人行为。
items.why_cn: 信贷行为偏差的因果证据对消费金融风控建模与信用因子构造有参考价值，也提醒行为金融研究者关注信息披露设计。

items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.summary_raw: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming pri
items.summary_cn: Depth Pro 2 提出全分辨率图像与视频的稠密度量深度估计方法：以往单目深度方法在时间一致性与边界锐度间取舍，多帧方法偏一致性、单帧方法偏锐度，该工作训练单一可扩展网络同时处理图像与视频，一次性实现度量准确、边界锐利、时间一致。
items.why_cn: 虽非金融论文，但单网络统一多任务、消除精度-一致性权衡的架构思路对多时间尺度金融序列建模有借鉴意义。

items.title: Scaling classical hardware for accurate real-time quantum error correction
items.summary_raw: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires a classical decoder fast enough to process syndrome measurements at the rate at which they are generated, and to return its decisions with low latency. This is most demanding for superconducting processors, whose fast syndrome cycles force a trade-off between decoding speed and accuracy. Decoders fast enough to keep up sacrifice accuracy, which must be compensated for with larger codes and thus additional physical qubits. Here we introduce Rapids, a streaming neural decoder that is both fast and accurate. We achieve this by co-designing the decoder w
items.summary_cn: 容错量子计算要求经典解码器以症状测量产生的速率低延迟处理，超导处理器的快速周期迫使速度与精度取舍。本文提出流式神经解码器 Rapids，通过与硬件协同设计兼顾速度与精度，减少为补偿精度而需要的额外物理量子比特。
items.why_cn: 神经网络实时解码的低延迟工程设计，与低延迟交易系统中「速度-精度权衡」的硬件协同优化思路高度同构。

items.title: Last Week in AI #348 - IPO->Correction, new GPTs and Geminis, Nvidia’s Fate
items.source: Last Week in AI (替代 The Batch)
items.summary_raw: Anthropic's $81B IPO, AI stocks enter a correction, Huang resigns from Nvidia, Trump and Xi agree on military AI
items.summary_cn: 本期 Last Week in AI 要点：Anthropic 以 810 亿美元估值 IPO，AI 板块股票进入回调，黄仁勋卸任英伟达职务，中美就军事 AI 达成协议。AI 产业资本市场热度与治理框架同步进入新阶段。
items.why_cn: AI 巨头资本事件与板块回调直接冲击 AI 概念股与算力产业链定价，是做 AI 主题交易的必跟宏观叙事。
